svg.text: The decided set, on two planes
Height is the outcome. Depth runs to the right, and it is the prompt. Each hairline is one of 299 decided tasks, 2026-09-21 snapshot.
168 failures on the bug report alone
On the bug report the 139 and the 29 are one pile of 168 failures. The full description lifts 139 of them and leaves 29 on the floor.
